dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been going recently?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Things are going great! Dad still doesn't remember a ton of stuff, but I'm just happy to have his company!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I've found some toys that we used to play with together. Maybe he'll remember a couple more things once he sees them!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I mean, I'd be okay even if he doesn't remember everything. We'll find new toys to play with, and we'll make new memories together!
